name: solo-rpg-workshop
description: Solo RPG toolkit: the core dice/table engine, the forge that builds ruleset modules and campaign vaults in your own folders, and (in development) a GM mode that runs published adventures.

plugins.name: solo-rpg-core
plugins.description: Auditable dice rolling, random-table lookups, record-keeping conventions and a cite-or-abstain rules lawyer.

plugins.name: solo-rpg-forge
plugins.description: Builds ruleset modules from rulebook PDFs, sets up Obsidian campaign vaults, and generates session-play skills.

plugins.name: solo-rpg-gm
plugins.description: In development: Claude runs a published adventure as GM. Builds hidden adventure modules from adventure PDFs, on top of a forge-built rules module.
